question: What request is made to have explained in what all things dissolve and into what that dissolution occurs?
premises: A question is raised about the locus of dissolution.
All things are said to go to dissolution.
A request is made to tell this to the speaker.
inference: The speaker requests to be told in what all things dissolve.
uncertainties: The answer specifying the locus of dissolution is not given in this verse.
plain_english: And indeed, in what does all this go to dissolution? Tell me all of that.
